newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remains mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remains mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices remained mostly steady on Thursday in slow activity, dealers said.

"It is quiet," a North Carolina dealer said. "Buyers are waiting to buy forward after they figure out how big the corn crop is going to be." There are also plenty of midd substitutes available, he said.

But in Buffalo, prices remained steady. "This market is still a reflection of a little less (flour mill) runtime than normal. That seems to be supporting prices at least in the northeast area," the Buffalo dealer said.
Demand appeared to be a little more "quieter" than it has been, he added.

Elsewhere, activity was featureless. "It was another quiet day. I can not say anything more than that, there have been several (feed) mixers buying some midds for next week," a Minneapolis dealer said.
